name: Shang Tsung killed Liu Kang
notes: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance presents Liu Kang's death during the sorcerers' Earthrealm attack, and Mortal Kombat: Deception later has Liu Kang explicitly state that Shang Tsung killed him. Quan Chi is a participant in the confrontation and assists Shang Tsung, but this Fact intentionally identifies only Shang Tsung as the killer because the later primary wording does so directly.
